_doc: Pinrose gallery room geometry, read from media/gallery.jpeg + media/gallery2.jpeg.
Units: centimetres. Plan frame: origin = where the west wall line meets the north wall line of the west (68 m2) section; +x = east (right on the plan), +y = south (down on the plan).

Each wall is a polyline along its MOUNTING FACE (the interior face, which is what the plan dimensions measure). 'side' says which side of the direction of travel that face looks into: 'right' or 'left' (in plan, y down). The wall body extends to the other side by 'thickness'.
kind: target = mounting wall of the Great Gallery (blue outline); optional = corridor wall, mountable only when the 'corridor walls' toggle is on; excluded = drawn for context, never mountable.
source: 'dimension' = length taken from a number written on the plan; 'plan-estimate' = position read off the drawing (no number on the plan) - CONFIRM ON SITE.
Distance-along-wall in the CSV export is measured from the FIRST point of the wall's polyline.

walls.label: NW diagonal (west section)
walls.note: Chamfer offsets = 860 (south run) - 600 (north run) = 260 cm on x; same 260 assumed on y (plan shows ~45 deg).

walls.label: East wall, south end (frame/door?)
walls.note: The black east wall continues ~60 cm past the end of the 811 dimension down to the slanted wall; a grey frame is drawn there. Treated as not mountable.

walls.label: South slanted wall (vitrine), east part
walls.note: Thin slanted wall (drawn as glazing/vitrine). Only the part east of where the blue outline cuts down is a target.

walls.label: Storage diagonal wall (foyer side)
walls.note: Between the foyer and the storage room.

walls.label: Diagonal '240' wall (entry wedge)
walls.note: 240 cm long at ~45 deg, starting at the column on the west/east divider (start point plan-estimated).

walls.label: Short wall at the end of the '240' wall
South wall, west section (storage wall)
walls.note: Gallery face of the wall shared with the storage room (מחסן). Length (610) read off the plan.

walls.label: West wall, south of door
walls.note: Door/opening assumed between y=400 and y=490.

walls.label: Corridor wall east of the gallery (optional)
walls.note: Grey wall continuing east from the SE corner, inside the blue outline. Not confirmed as a mounting wall; face assumed to be the south (corridor) side.
